title: A key with G at home
summary: Use the same recipe from G.

steps.title: A key with G at home
steps.body:
**key** means a home note and the group of notes built around it. The key of G major has G at home and uses G, A, B, C, D, E and F#. F# keeps the major scale formula when we start on G.

**Why it matters:** A key tells you which notes belong together and where home is.

steps.title: Find the notes
steps.body: G to A is whole, A to B whole, B to C half, C to D whole, D to E whole, E to F# whole, F# to G half. Use F#, not F.

items.prompt: Play G, A, B, C, D, E, F#, G in that order, one note at a time.

steps.title: Make it familiar
steps.body: Try F then F# before returning to G. Hear which one gives the small final half step.

items.prompt: What is the tonic of this scale?
Play G, A, B, C, D, E, F#, G in that order, one note at a time.
